what_this_is: Every key a script of this tool reads from the person's settings: the settings object of their list:settings row record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>, read by tools/settings (read-data/settings.py), with the request's own settings laid over it. The tool carries no values: the character's voice, the show's formats, the words and the videos are the person's. Each script needs only the keys it names; a run with one missing, or of the wrong type, is refused, naming it.

character_label.meaning: The label the person gave the character's windows when seeding (find_voice seed); every other label is not the character.

embed_min_pitch_hz.meaning: A window is embedded when its median pitch is at least the smaller of this and embed_pitch_ratio times the recording's median pitch; the seed model's held-out check also counts only windows at least this high.

embed_pitch_ratio.meaning: See embed_min_pitch_hz: how far above the recording's median pitch the character sits.

gate_pitch_ratio.meaning: A window can be the character only when its pitch is at least the smaller of gate_max_hz and this times the recording's median pitch.

gate_max_hz.meaning: See gate_pitch_ratio: the pitch gate never asks more than this (Hz).

voice_cosine_min.meaning: Cosine similarity to this recording's voice of the character above which a gated window is the character.

batch_format_order.meaning: The catalog formats a batch embeds and scores, in this order; other formats are skipped.

audio_file.meaning: The name of a video's audio file in the audio folder, with {id} for the video id (for example {id}.m4a).

pitch_run_band_low_hz.meaning: Lowest pitch of the character's band for the pitch-run finder (Hz).

pitch_run_band_high_hz.meaning: Highest pitch of the character's band, and the tracker's ceiling, for the pitch-run finder (Hz).

series_prefixes.meaning: {title start: format}: a video whose lower-case title starts so is of that format (a series of its own).

compilation_words.meaning: A video whose lower-case title holds one of these words is a compilation.

side_pattern.meaning: A regular expression: a video whose lower-case title matches it is a side piece (character pieces, songs, promos, channel notes).

caption_turn_pitch_ratio.meaning: A caption speaker turn counts as the character's when its median window pitch is at least this times the episode's median pitch (the request's ratio wins).

mention_pattern.meaning: A regular expression: a comment names the character when it matches, in any case.

codebook.meaning: The codes a comment that names the character may get, in the person's order: {code: regular expression} or [[code, regular expression], ...] (a list keeps the order in a settings row), matched in any case; one that matches none is coded mention-only.

terms.meaning: The running jokes, lore names and rituals to count in the captions: {term: regular expression} or [[term, regular expression], ...] (a list keeps the order in a settings row), matched in any case.

opening_seconds.meaning: The opening of an episode (seconds from its start: cold open, sponsor sketch) whose character time is summed on its own.

closing_seconds.meaning: The close of an episode (seconds before its end: outro, plugs) whose character time is summed on its own.

stripped_ids.meaning: The video ids the character was cut from, compared with the full episodes.

compare_from_month.meaning: First month (YYYYMM) of the stripped against full comparison.

compare_to_month.meaning: Last month (YYYYMM) of the stripped against full comparison.

lowest_from_year.meaning: Year (YYYY) from which the episodes with the least character time are listed.
